messages:
Jules (sales): Prospect wants a 12mo reserved commit. Workload: daytime batch embeddings high QPS, evenings chat spikes 100-350 QPS with long tails. They want guidance: how many GPUs to reserve vs autoscale/burst?

Maya (solutions): Need avg/peak QPS and tokens.

Jules (sales): Avg daytime 180 rps embeddings (64 tokens), chat baseline 80 rps (200 tokens), spikes to 300 rps for ~30s, worst-case 1k tokens. Latency target 250ms p95.

Diego (eng-runtime): Quick compute: embeddings ~180*64=11520 tps, chat baseline 80*200=16000 tps => steady ~27520 tps. With conservative throughput ~1400 tps/GPU => steady ~= 20 GPUs. Peak transient adds ~ (300-80)*200=44000 => total ~71520 tps => ~52 GPUs peak.

Priya (sre): Can't reserve 52. Recommend hybrid: reserve baseline for steady (20) or smaller (12) plus prewarm + burst credits + model fallback for spikes.

Maya (solutions): Proposal: reserve 12 GPUs, prewarm 6 (partial cost), burst pool up to +40 GPUs for 120s, autoscale max 60 GPUs. Add fallback to a quantized chat model for overload.

Jules (sales): They asked cost predictability: how are bursts billed if frequent?

billing-bot: Bursts consume prepaid burst credits; excess converted to overage at on-demand rates. If burst usage >30% monthly, recommend convert to higher commit or true-up.

Diego (eng-runtime): Suggested autoscale config (plain text):
```
committed: 12
prewarm: 6
burst_pool: 40
autoscale_max: 60
scale_up_window: 20s
scale_down_window: 90s
backup_route: quantized-chat
```
Note: rely on burst_pool for short 30s spikes; scale-up is slower.

Priya (sre): Security: prewarm runs in tenant-dedicated pool; no cross-tenant cache exposure. We'll include KMS + audit logging in SOW.

Maya (solutions): I'll draft SOW blurb: reserve 12 GPUs, 6 prewarm, burst up to 40 for short windows, autoscale to 60, model fallback for high latency, monthly review to right-size.

Jules (sales): Thanks — will share with their procurement. Priya/Maya please add short cost appendix.

billing-bot: [ticket] create cost appendix task assigned to Maya (solutions).
